And on the next slide...Zzzzz 

    Don't let your PowerPoint presentation turn into naptime. Twenty-six bullet points per slide, lousy clip art, and nonsensical jargon in a PowerPoint is what the comic-strip character Dilbert famously referred to as "PowerPoint poisoning." Find the antidote by joining the discussion in CNET's Better Presentations with PowerPoint 2007 online course. PowerPoint expert Helen Bradley teaches you how to deliver a lively presentation with better templates, slides, and designs as well as practical advice on how to keep your audience members from falling asleep with their eyes open.  


Is your Windows XP PC showing its age with slow load times and unstable performance? Join Windows troubleshooter Andrew Kantor in CNET's Speed Up Your Windows PC online course and learn how to breathe new life into an older PC with a few easy tweaks that you can do on your lunch hour.
